Pooled · base + options

Forecast error relative to the empirical historical-distribution baseline. Positive improvement means lower error; it is not a trading return. All 393 requested tickers, 15 architecture slots and nine evaluation windows are accounted for, including exclusions and failed fits.

Architecture summary

All-period improvement = 100 × (1 − sum model loss / sum paired baseline loss). Means are weighted by forecast counts. Missing results never enter evaluated denominators. Ticker wins aggregate a ticker's losses first. A small improvement is descriptive evidence, not a significance claim.

Protocol, interpretation and limits

These are fixed-protocol exploratory evaluations in 2024–2025, distinct from the prior simple-model study's 2023 model selection. No new hyperparameter search or optimized-model claim. All advanced weights were initialized randomly. Library backbones feed DS Kit's common three-component Gaussian-mixture distribution head.

Fixed learning rate 0.0003; AdamW, weight decay 0.01; gradient clip 5; patience 20; ceiling 500; seed 11; batch up to 512 pooled or 64 unpooled. Best epoch identifies the restored checkpoint; total epochs include patience. Epoch-ceiling failures remain skips. Optimizer updates, fit/monitor rows, dates, actual encoder settings and parameter counts are shown above.

Only fitting data determine imputation, scaling and constant-feature masking. Target normalization remains return/reference scale. Bands are purged. Weighted CRPS = CRPS + tail CRPS; lower is better. Tail intervals are normalized [−2.5, −0.5] and [0.5, 2.5]; evaluation uses 201 CRPS quantiles and 101 tail midpoints per interval.

Local parameter budget ≤ min(8,192, 4 × fit rows). Pooled budget ≤ min(100,000, total fit rows / 4), with each ticker's head also limited by its own history. The largest declared width passing the budget is used. These capacity choices are part of this experiment, not controlled equal-size architecture comparisons.

Options arms train only on observed options-era rows. Individual option fields may still be missing; imputation and constant masks are fit-only. Admission requires at least one observed option feature per row and at least 128 fitting rows, 20 monitoring rows and eight disjoint label intervals. Folds 33–39 are ineligible; at most 276 tickers qualify in fold 40 and 300 in fold 41 before capacity gates. Matched-history base uses the same eligible history and base features. Different retained widths mean that any difference cannot be attributed entirely to options.

Informer and TimesNet are skipped for deterministic row-independence failures. BiTCN is skipped because the supplied inputs lack the future-covariate branch defining the architecture. Other capacity, numerical, native-library and epoch-ceiling outcomes are retained with their reasons.

A weak ticker head does not establish that removing its training data would help a pooled model. These runs do not test that ablation or validate monthly winner selection. Selecting tickers using these inspected 2024–2025 results would be exploratory. A rule selected on a separate earlier warmup must be frozen before assessing later outcomes.

The 2026 holdout was not accessed. Dates are prediction dates; some final 2025 forecasts settle in January 2026 before the locked holdout. Forecast accuracy does not establish trading profitability.
